top_signals.title: Lockheed Martin Europe CEO on Deterrence, Transatlantic Partnerships
top_signals.summary: The European CEO of US defence company Lockheed Martin said transatlantic partnerships such as the one with Rheinmetall will build a credible deterrence and economic benefits on both sides. Dennis Goege spoke with Bloomberg’s Lizzy Burden from Frankfurt. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
